# RULING 14 — STANDING acceptance for routine refreshes. Escalate only on a real signal.
Orchestrator, 2026-09-14. Answers the remaining `separate provider/FTC/observation acceptance` blocker.

## Deliverable 2 works — say so plainly in the result
**Natural run satisfied: 7/7 due captures, 3/3 observation checks, exit 0.** That is the scheduled machine
refreshing evidence on its own, which is exactly what item #1 of the backlog asked for. Record it as met.

## The trap I am closing before it forms
LifeMD's evidence expires **2026-09-15 17:13:43 UTC** — tomorrow. Provider, FTC and observation captures each
expire on their own clocks. If every one needs a bespoke orchestrator ruling the way the FDA capture did, this
machine needs a human in the loop forever and we have rebuilt the ceremony we spent yesterday deleting.

The FDA capture needed my explicit adoption because it was the **first use of an unproven trust mechanism**.
That mechanism is now proven: the post-fix review demonstrated a fabricated capture cannot be adopted against an
unchanged external record. Proven machinery does not need re-proving per item.

## STANDING ACCEPTANCE — routine refreshes proceed without a ruling
A capture refresh is **routine and self-accepting** when ALL of these hold:
1. It went through the registered refresh path and the proven adoption mechanism.
2. Provenance is real and recorded: authoritative source URL, fetch time, content hash.
3. **The retained exact_quote (or equivalent supported claim) is still present in the refreshed body**, verified
   the way I verified the FDA one — matched against the new capture, not assumed.
4. `retained_claims_supported: true` and `missing_claims: []`.
5. No guard, limit, timestamp or independent quote/scrape pin was touched.

Meeting all five, the machine refreshes and adopts on its own. No ruling, no queue item, no journal entry.

## ESCALATE TO ME — immediately, and stop — when ANY of these
- **A retained claim loses support**, or `missing_claims` is non-empty.
- **A material content change** on health, regulatory, pricing or provider-eligibility claims.
- The **authoritative source is unreachable, moved without a clean redirect, or refuses**.
- A refresh would require touching a **provider quote or scrape pin**, a guard, a limit or a timestamp.
- A **new trust chain or capture class** appears that the proven mechanism has not covered.
- Anything that would change **what the site claims**.

That last one is the line. The machine may keep evidence current on its own; it may never change what we tell
people without a human seeing it.

## So, concretely
- Provider/FTC/observation captures adopt through the standing acceptance above.
- **LifeMD expires tomorrow 17:13:43 UTC — the schedule must refresh it BEFORE that**, not after it blocks a
  build. Confirm the schedule actually covers it and read that back.
- Record this standing acceptance as a receipt so it survives context, and reference it from the machine.

## Then
GLP-34 listing class → GLP-229 → GLP-208 Parts A/B → next eligible. Progress in RESOLVED MEMBERS.

Your session has compressed 9 times; accuracy degrades past that. Bank your RESULT, then I will start you fresh
and point you back at this file.
scope: Routine captures meeting ALL five R14 conditions; all six escalation triggers remain. This receipt records the orchestrator grant, not an individual capture adoption.
